rule_definitions.private_key_header: -----BEGIN(?: RSA| DSA| EC| OPENSSH| ENCRYPTED)? PRIVATE KEY-----
rule_definitions.private_runtime_path: Tracked path components assets/state/scratch/knowledge/_staging; config.local.toml/.env; extensions .sqlite3/.sqlite/.db/.secret/.jsonl. knowledge/.gitkeep allowed only as an empty tracked sentinel; its content is not read.

classification_policy: Prior path/rule/line classifications require the exact captured-byte Git blob hash or a recomputed LF/CRLF-equivalent exact blob hash (older audits captured raw CRLF worktree bytes while Git stores canonical LF). Newly detected Discord-shaped matches must be entirely within an exact qualified unittest identifier whose module/class/test method exists in current public test AST; no whole-directory or token-prefix exemptions.
scope: All commits and blob/path variants reachable from local main only, plus current WORKTREE bytes of git-index tracked files including staged additions. No refs/codex, branches other than main, untracked attachments, actual configuration, knowledge sources, state or scratch contents are accessed. This snapshot includes final staged 0.12.0 docs and offline/wheel reports. The audit output itself is metadata only and excluded from recursive self-scan.
limitations: Finite explicit credential-shape and tracked-runtime-path rules; arbitrary secrets, assignments without those shapes, external releases/artifacts, and later unstaged changes are not certified. This is a publication-content audit, not live service/model/Discord validation.

documentation_local_links.scope: Local Markdown file targets only; no remote URL requests, anchor verification or private file contents.
